1.web: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
1.asv: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

2.web: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
2.asv: and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

3.web: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
3.asv: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

4.web: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
4.asv: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father:

5.web: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
5.asv: to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

6.web: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;
6.asv: I marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of Christ unto a different gospel;

7.web: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
7.asv: which is not another gospel: only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

8.web: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
8.asv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.

9.web: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
9.asv: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.

10.web: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
10.asv: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? or am I striving to please men? if I were still pleasing men, I should not be a servant of Christ.

11.web: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
11.asv: For I make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.

12.web: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
12.asv: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

13.web: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.
13.asv: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and made havoc of it:

14.web: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
14.asv: and I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

15.web: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,
15.asv: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me, even from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,

16.web: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
16.asv: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; straightway I conferred not with flesh and blood:

17.web: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
17.asv: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned unto Damascus.

18.web: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
18.asv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.

19.web: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.
19.asv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

20.web: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
20.asv: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

21.web: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
21.asv: Then I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

22.web: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
22.asv: And I was still unknown by face unto the churches of Judæa which were in Christ:

23.web: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
23.asv: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;

24.web: And they glorified God in me.
24.asv: and they glorified God in me.
